summary:
A highly dedicated and technically skilled Service Engineer with over 8 years of progressive
experience in the installation, calibration, maintenance, and component-level repair of
complex electronic equipment, particularly in the domain of radiation safety and industrial
monitoring instruments. Seeking a Sr. Service Engineer role to leverage proven expertise in
PCB troubleshooting, circuit analysis, and critical system support to drive efficiency and
quality assurance in a challenging, growth-oriented environment.

pre_date_header: Nathani Industrial Services Pvt. Ltd. | Mumbai, India
bullets: Led the installation, calibration, preventive, and corrective maintenance of specialized radiation safety and electronic monitoring instruments for critical clients.

Routinely performed component-level PCB repair, diagnosing complex faults, executing precise component replacement and circuit corrections, maintaining a high first-time fix rate and reducing system downtime.

Delivered high-level technical support, training, and product demonstrations, fostering strong relationships with major industrial and research clients, including Tata Steel, Maruti Suzuki, B.A.R.C., and B.R.I.T.
Implemented and maintained Scrap Monitoring Systems (using Ludlum Model 4525) and managed Radiation Portal Monitors for vehicle/material screening.
Executed Optical Fiber Cable (OFC) conversions to optimize data communication reliability in monitoring systems.

bullets: Successfully installed radiation instruments at highly sensitive nuclear facilities (B.A.R.C., B.R.I.T.), ensuring adherence to stringent safety and operational protocols.
Involved in the production, comprehensive testing, and quality control (QC) of radiation safety instruments and electronic assemblies.
Collaborated with R&D teams to provide feedback on electronic circuit performance, contributing to product reliability improvements.
Operated and maintained a range of instruments including microR / microSv Meters, Hand & Foot Monitors, Pocket Dosimeters, and Continuous Air Monitors.
